entries.en: What do I do when I have some money saved up?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: お金があり余るようになったら？
entries.en: What do I do when I have too much money?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 何か質問はありますか？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: いい質問ですね！呪われているものは食べると吐いてしまい、逆にお腹が減ったり場合によっては即餓死したりします。呪われているかは鑑定することでわかりますが、空腹の仲間の足元に置いてみて食いつくかでもわかります。どんなにお腹が空いていても、仲間は足元の呪われている食べ物には手を出しません。
entries.en: Good question! Cursed food will make you throw up and get even hungrier, and that can leave you starving. Of course, you can identify it to determine if the food is cursed, but another way of finding out is to place it at the feet of a hungry ally. Your allies will never eat cursed food off the ground no matter how hungry they are.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: あと、腐ったものを食べると能力が永続的に下がります。腐っていても消化できるようになる装備もありますが、クーラーボックスや四次元にしまって腐らないように対策しましょう。
entries.en: Rotten food will permanently decrease your attributes. There's equipment that you can wear to let you digest rotten food, but in the meantime you should just stick food into a cooler box or 4-dimensional storage to stop it from rotting.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: ただし、特定のアンデッドの死体は見た目上腐っていなくても腐っているので気をつけて。骨のやつなんかは大丈夫ですが、動く死体系のやつらは腐っていますよ。
entries.en: That said, you must be very careful of the corpses from some undead. They are rotten even if they don't look like it. The bony kind of undead are fine, but the ones that are basically walking corpses are all rotten.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 他にはエイリアンなどの寄生生物の死体を食べると寄生、輝くハリねずみやウィスプなんかはエーテル病を進行させます。発狂したり毒になる死体もあります。怖いですか？でもプチ系や馬系みたいに能力に経験値が入るものや、サソリや妖精みたいに属性耐性を得られる特殊なものもあるので、対策を用意したうえで色々食べて覚えていきましょう。
entries.en: Other corpses you should watch out for are aliens and other parasitic creatures that you make you pregnant. Shining hedgehogs and wisps will hasten the progression of ether disease. And there are always those that will make you mad, poison you, and so on. It's not all bad, though, because some of the latter are like putits and horses in that they will train your attributes. Scorpions and fairies will even grant resistances to some elements, so you should try eating them. After you've made the necessary preparations, of course.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: のどが渇いて脱水症までいくと疲労します。死にはしませんがね。疲労すると技能は使えなくなり動作も鈍くなるので、戦闘が難しくなります。早めに何かを飲みましょう。雨や水場で濡れれば、少しずつ回復することも覚えておいてください。
entries.en: When you're thirsty to the point of dehydration, you'll become tired. It won't kill you though. But being tired means you're slower and won't be able to use special actions, so combat will be harder, so drink something soon. Also, if you get wet in the rain or in a puddle, you'll slowly quench your thirst.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 遠出する際には、食べ物だけでなく飲み物も用意しておきましょう。ジュースミキサーがあれば果物や野菜からジュースを作ってのどを潤すことができます。呪われていたり腐っている物でも無害化して有効活用できます。街中であればバーテンダーに飲み物を注文してもいいですね。
entries.en: If you plan on travelling, pack both food and drinks.If you have a juice mixer, you can make juice from fruits and vegetables for drinking. It will also make normal juice from cursed or rotten produce, so that way you never waste anything. If you're in town, you can get something to drink from a bartender.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 料理スキルがあるなら、調理器具を使うことで料理ができます。料理すると、腐るまでのタイムリミットと心身を鍛える効果が大幅に伸びるので、できるようになっておきたいですね。料理が上達するほど強化値が付与され、鍛え効果と価格が増加していきます。腐ったものも料理の練習台にするくらいの気持ちで頑張りましょう。調理器具によって、どこまでの料理を作れるか限界があるので一度道具説明欄を見て下さい。
entries.en: If you have the Cooking skill, then just use cooking tools to make cooked food. Food lasts for a lot longer and trains attributes by a much greater amount when cooked, so it's an important skill to have. The more improve cooking, the more reinforcement value food will receive, and the training effect and price will increase. You may want to practise cooking whenever you can, even on rotten food.  The rank of cooked food is limited by the type of cooking tool, so have a look at the tool descriptions.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 牧場を持っていれば、料理スキルがなくても干し肉を作ることができます。栄養と価値はそこそこですが、保存性がバツグンです。あとは、素材が燃えて料理になることもありますが…ろくな品にならないので、下手でも自分で料理したほうがマシだと思います。むしろ、勝手に燃やされないように注意してください。
entries.en: If you have a ranch, you can make jerky even without the Cooking skill. It's not that great in terms of nutrition and selling price, but it keeps for a long time. You could also set ingredients on fire to cook them... but they're never going to turn out well, so you should try to keep your food from burning up. Cook yourself if you can even if you're not good at it.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: えぇぇ…僕の好物ですか？そ、そうですね。ハーブでしょうか。腐らないし軽いし、心身も鍛えられるんですよ。合成の壺で料理に混ぜると最高ですね。
entries.en: My favourite kind of food...? Uh. Um, herbs, I guess. They never rot, they're light, and train both your body and mind. They're even better when you infuse cooked food with them.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 大別して、地殻変動で出たり消えたりするランダムネフィアと、地殻変動で消えない固定ネフィアがあります。
entries.en: There are two types in general - random Nefia that appear and disappear with tectonic diastrophisms, and unique ones that stay put.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: ランダムネフィアは３層で構成され、最下層のボスを倒せば攻略完了となり宝が手に入ります。ボスを倒す前に最下層から逃げると、失敗となり攻略不能になります。あと、ランダムネフィアの表層以外の階層には、金貨が集められている箇所が必ず存在します。なんだかネフィアが冒険者を誘っているみたいで不気味ですが…ありがたく拾っておきましょう。
entries.en: Random Nefia have 3 floors and a boss on the bottom floor that drops treasure when defeated. If you go out of the last floor before defeating the boss, you'll fail to clear the Nefia and won't be able to try it again. Random Nefia also have gold pieces scattered throughout them - but never on their first floor. They're like bait to attract adventurers... creepy if you ask me, but hey it's free money.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 固定ネフィアは位置も固定されており動きません。外見や名前が固有のものが多いので、ランダムネフィアとはそこで判別してください。２層程度の浅いものから４０層以上あるものまで様々です。独自のルールや環境を持っている固定ネフィアもあります。
entries.en: Unique Nefia will always be on the same spot. Most of them also have a unique appearance that allows you to tell them apart from random Nefia. Inside, they can range anywhere from 2 to 40 or more floors. Some of them even impose special conditions or have unique environments.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: ランダムネフィアは元となった遺跡に応じて８タイプあります。それぞれ住み着いている種族が違うので、目当ての魔物を探す時は対応したタイプのネフィアを探すといいでしょう。固定ネフィアは基本的に種族のごった煮ですが、そうでないものもあったりと一概には言えませんね。
entries.en: Random Nefia can be classified into 8 types, depending on the ruins that they are based on. Nefia type dictates the races of monsters that inhabit it, so if you're searching for certain types of monsters, you can narrow down the Nefia you need to search. In general, unique Nefia are inhabited by every monster race, but there are some exceptions.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: カルマが－３１まで下がると、犯罪者として指名手配されます。街中のガードが一斉に殺しに来て、店の人も物を売ってくれなくなります。ガードを一蹴できる強さと、変装手段を確保するまではカルマを下げすぎないよう慎重に行動してください。
entries.en: When your karma falls below -30, you will be wanted as a criminal. All guards in towns will make a beeline for you and shopkeepers will no longer sell anything to you. Unless you're strong enough to handle the guards with ease or can disguise yourself, then manage your karma carefully.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: もし、思いがけず犯罪者になってしまったら。このゼミから南西にある、ダルフィという街を拠点にして依頼などでカルマを上げてください。ダルフィにはガードがおらず、犯罪者でも店も使えますからね。
entries.en: If you find yourself a criminal, then you should head over to the town of Derphy south-west from here. Over there, you can complete some jobs to bring your karma back up. There aren't any guards there and their shopkeepers also don't mind dealing with criminals.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 発言力は街への貢献度の証。そこの管理者や長に話しかけることで、発言力を使って街の管理代行を行うことができます。…と言ってもまだできたばかりの制度で、やれることは少ないんですけどね。現段階では、依頼のついでで貯まっていくものだと認識してください。
entries.en: Authority is a measure of how much you've contributed to a town. By talking to the person in charge there like their elder, you can use that authority as a proxy to enact laws in town. Or should be able to, anyway. It's a new system, so there's not much you can do with it at this point. For now, it's just something that accumulates as you do jobs for the people in town.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 街が大火事になったり、モンスターが湧いて虐殺が始まることがよくあります。よくないことだけど、よくあることなんです。…ごほん。火の消し方とモンスターの出現を止める方法を教えておきましょう。
entries.en: Is a town burning to the ground? Are there monsters going around killing everyone? Yeah that sucks, but that's life. I mean- I'll give you some tips on putting out fires and stopping monsters from spawning.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: まず火の消し方。火が一つ二つなら、手持ちのポーション類をそこにＴキー（shift+t）…Throwすることで鎮火できます。水たまりを誰かが踏むと怒られるので、自分で踏んで消しておきましょう。ポーションを上手く投げられなかったり、火が四つ五つに増えてきたら、蜘蛛の巣や闇の霧、水系の魔法を使いましょう。杖版でもいいですけど。これらは対象範囲の火を消してくれます。そんなものは持っていなかったり、火が燃え広がりすぎている時は、雨の日までその街には近寄らないことをオススメします。
entries.en: So, about fires. If there are only one or two, then you can 'T'hrow (shift + 't' key) potions to put them out. People get mad if they step on puddles made by you, so be sure to step on them yourself to get rid of them after you're done. If you can't seem to hit with your fires and the fire spreads to 4 or 5 tiles, you can use spells of web or mist of darkness, or any of the water spells. These can put out fires in a large area. If you don't have any of those, or if the fire is already burning out of control, then you might want to stay out of town until a rainy day.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 続いてモンスターが湧く場合。井戸を飲んだ時に出てきたものは、倒してしまえば終わりです。しかしモンスターを無限に召喚する装備を付けた冒険者が徘徊していることがあります。これは、犯人を見つけてその装備を没収しましょう。
entries.en: Monsters that spawn from drinking from a well aren't much of a problem - kill them to resolve the problem. But sometimes adventurers can have equipment that will keep spawning monsters. In this case, you will need to track down the source of the monsters and take that piece of equipment off their hands.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: エイリアンなどの寄生生物が腹から出てくることもあります。腹にいる間なら毒や染料、硫酸を飲むことで完全駆除できますよ。寄生されている人には渡せば素直に飲んでくれます。むしろ飲ませないと宿主が生きている限り無限に産まれてくるんです。
entries.en: Aliens will spawn from impregnated people. Just hand poisons, dyes, or acids to the pregnant to cure them of it. They'll drink it quite happily if they're pregnant. If they don't get rid of the pregnancy, they'll just keep giving birth over and over again.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 寄生生物がすでに産まれすぎていたり、モンスターがモンスターを召喚したり、分裂して増殖しているケースもありますね。相手が倒せる強さなら、壁生成で囲って各個撃破しましょう。倒せない場合、街から脱出してください。５日ほどして様子を見に行くと、いなくなっているはずです。もし少し残っていたら、また日を改めましょう。
entries.en: Sometimes you'll find too many people giving birth, or maybe you might find a monster that keeps summoning more monsters. Or there could be a monster that keeps splitting indefinitely. If these monsters aren't too strong for for you to handle, you can just create some walls to fight them individually. If you can't handle them, then hightail it out of there. Waiting 5 days should be enough to get rid of them. If they're still there, then try coming back another day.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 違う神の祭壇に捧げものをすることで、その祭壇を乗っ取って上書きすることができます。何も考えていないと、次に信仰したい神の祭壇が無くなることもあるでしょう。神の祭壇は特定の場所に置いてある分か、ネフィアでごく稀に生成されるものしかありません。後者が目当ての神のものである確率は単純に考えて八分の一です。代わりを確保していない状態で無計画に乗っ取るのは止めておきましょう。
entries.en: If you try to make offerings at the altar of a god that's not the one you're currently worshipping, your god will take over that altar. If you're not careful about this, you might not have an altar of a god that you want to switch to later on. Aside from the few altars that are at a couple of locations, they will only appear very rarely in Nefia. Even if you did manage to find an altar in a Nefia, there's only a 1/8 chance of it being one of the god you want, on top of the chance that it might be unclaimed. So be careful to leave one altar for every god.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 信仰スキルは、夢を通じて神の偉大さを感じることで受動的に上昇します。また、信仰スキル１０以上の時にレベルアップすれば、広域技能の説法を習得できます。説法で聴衆を満足させることができれば、信仰スキルを能動的に上昇させられますよ。
entries.en: Getting visited by saints in your dream will deepen your faith. When you level up with 10 Faith or more, you will learn how to Preach, a 'W'ide area special action. When you preach and your audience is satisfied, this will also increase your Faith.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 最初は、捧げものが簡単で生存能力を強化してくれるオパートスやジュア、生計を助けてくれるヤカテクトがいいでしょうね。アイテムを大人買いできる資金ができてきたらマニやルルウィ、イツパロトルも簡単です。エヘカトルは釣りができるようになってから、クミロミは農業ができるようになってからが無難です。
entries.en: For your first god, you could pick Opatos or Jure whose offerings are easy to acquire and will also increase your survivability. Or you could go with Yacatect, who will make it easier for you to earn money. With money, worshipping Lulwy, Itzpalt, and Mani will be easy. You may want to worship Ehekatl and Kumiromi only after acquiring the Fishing and Gardening skills respectively.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 多くの冒険者は、神々を何柱か信仰してご褒美をもらった後に最終信仰を決めていますね。全ての神を信仰コンプリートする者も少なくありません。神々は能力も性格も個性的なので、最終的には自分のスタイルに合っている神を選ぶといいでしょう。もちろん、面白さとか可愛さとかで決めてもいいんですけどね。
entries.en: Many adventurers change the god they worship several times before finally settling on one for good. Some of them even go through every single one of them in that process. Worshipping different gods will be different due to their unique boons offered and personalities, so you will have to decide which one is the best fit for you. Of course, you can always just go with the cutest or the most interesting one.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: …これはファッションです。腐って変色しているわけではないのです。
entries.en: ...It's hair. It's supposed to be fashionable. This lock of hair is not of a different colour because it's gone bad or anything.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: だいたいどの物件にも使い道はあります。所持金と相談して、苦にならない範囲で買ってみましょう。博物館ははく製やカードを並べていくと、そこそこのお金やプラチナ硬貨が入手できます。畑は栽培スキルが必要ですが、軌道に乗れば様々なアイテムが手に入ります。充分にスキルがあればハーブも増産できますしね。
entries.en: Most deeds have a purpose, so buy one when you're sure it won't break your bank. Museums display figures and cards and yield gold and platinum pieces in income. Farms need Gardening skill to be useful, but yield all sorts of items once they're up and running. You can even mass-produce herbs with enough skill.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 建ててからやっぱりいらないな、と思ったらワールドマップ上で拾うことで撤去できます。権利書は戻ってきませんがね。場所を変えたい時は物件移設です。移設申請書があれば、内装そのままで移設ができるので安心ですね。
entries.en: If you want to get rid of a building after constructing it, 'g'rab it on the world map to get rid of it. You don't get the deed back though. If you just want to move it, use a deed of property transfer to keep the interior the way it was.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 交易には、各地の交易店でのみ売れる交易品が必要です。交易品は旅糧以外の（荷車）アイテムのことで、荷車に積まれます。街ごとに安いもの高いものが違うので、荷車の積載限界まで積んで別の街まで運び、差額を利用して稼ぐことになります。交易品を工具で自作したり、盗賊団から強奪すれば効率が上がります。
entries.en: To trade, you will need trade goods that can be bought and sold only at traders in towns. Trade goods are those cargo items that go into your cart except for traveler's food. Different towns have will have different prices for each type of trade goods, so the idea here is fill your cart in one town, sell it off in another, and reap the price difference as profit. You can also craft trade goods yourself or get them from dispatching rogue attacks.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: ただし、「交易だけ」で大儲けするのは大変です。生活費分くらいは余裕で稼げますが、基本は街から街へ移動するついでに併用して行うものですよ。なお、他所からの交易品を売却すると、額に応じて街の経済が活性化し、一時的に他店の品物数も増えます。そちら目当てで交易するのもいいでしょう。
entries.en: However, making a living from only trading is going to be difficult. It will bring in enough profits to pay for most of your expenses, but it's something that you should do on the side while moving from town to town. There's one more benefit to trading. Selling trade goods from other towns will stimulate the economy by an amount dependent on how much you've sold and temporarily increase the number of items that shopkeepers in that town will sell.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 所持金に余裕があるなら、地面に落ちている金貨は拾わずに仲間に拾わせるといいでしょう。勝手に訓練に行ってくれるようになります。…これは育成講座の分野ですかね？
entries.en: If you have enough money, then consider leaving gold pieces on the floor there for your allies to pick up. They'll use it to train their potentials in town. ...I think you'll learn more about that in the Training seminars.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 後は、装備を強化して性能を底上げしていきましょう。＋６までは対応する巻物で強化できますが、武具店で＋１０まで強化できます。現行でいい感じの防具などは、ケチらずに強化しておくと後で仲間のお下がりとして重宝しますよ。また、装備している物の平均＋値は力の解放…ゲージ技の威力にも影響します。平均＋１０でダメージが５倍以上まで伸びるので、覚えておきましょう。
entries.en: You can also use that money to improve your equipment. Enchant scrolls will get them up to +6, and a blacksmith can bring that up to +10. If you have a decent piece of equipment, it's probably best not to be stingy and enchant it right away, then pass it to your allies when you find something better. One thing to remember is that the average +enhance value of all your equipment will determine the power of your gauge attacks, done by using Gauge Release. At an average of +10, the multiplier on gauge attacks reaches a whopping x5.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: …っと。これは道具講座の分野ですね。つまり、お金は生計を立てるだけでなく、様々な戦力強化にも絡んでくる材料なんです。惜しまずにちゃんと使っていきましょう。先に安定した収入基盤さえ作っておけば、また稼げるんですから。
entries.en: ...That was material that's supposed to be covered by the Item seminars. But anyway, money is useful for more than letting you live a cushy life - it can enable you to fight better. Don't be stingy, because you can always earn more as long as you've already made the necessary investments.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: お金があり余ってきたら、よく使う店に投資しましょう。自宅に招いてる店に投資するようにすれば、特定の街に縛られずに引っ越しができますよ。投資すると扱う品物の質や数が向上します。規模１５０もあれば十分でしょう。
entries.en: If you have money to burn, then invest in shops. If you invest in the shopkeepers hired in your home, that investment will be there even if you move your house elsewhere. By investing, the quality and number of items that they sell will increase. About 150 ranks should suffice.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: それでも余ったら？うーん…仲間を増やしてみるとか、複数の武具店やブラックマーケットにさらに投資するとか？特に何もなければ、貯金箱に入れておいたほうがいいですよ。現在の所持金に応じて税金が増えるだけですからね。
entries.en: If you still have money after that... Hmm. Maybe invest in multiple blacksmiths and blackmarkets vendors? If you don't really have anything to spend it on, you should just put it in a kitty bank. After all, taxes increase based on the money that you have on you.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: じゃあ質問のある人は直接聞きに来てください。
entries.en: Alright, if anyone has anymore questions you can come see me at the front.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 道具講座担当のクレッシェ・ルカンよ。れっしぇーって呼んでね！
entries.en: Hey everybody, I'm Cresce Lucan, your lecturer for the Item Seminars. You can just call me Ressie.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 冒険者を始めたばかりだと、どの道具が重要でどの道具がさほど重要でないのか、わからないと思うの。だから用意するべき道具を簡単に説明しておくわね。
entries.en: If you're just starting off, you might not know which items are useful and which aren't, so that's what I'm going to cover today.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: まずは１つずつでいいから持っておきたいものとして、紐、聴診器、コマンドフラッグ、ホイッスル。その辺で普通に拾えたり買えたりするけれど、後から手に入れようとするとなかなか見つからないのよね。
entries.en: I'm going to start with the ones that are must haves - the leash, stethoscope, command flag, and whistle. You can buy or find these just about everywhere, but they're surprisingly hard to find when you need them.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 音楽のディスク、カード、はく製などは、戦闘には関係ないけど集めておくと使う日が来るかも。後から揃えるのは大変なものだし、売るのはダブったものだけにしようね。
entries.en: You should collect music discs and figures. They don't do anything in combat, but the time may come when you need them so start collecting. If you neglect doing that, it's going to be really tiresome to start your collection from scratch later. If you have any duplicates, you can just sell them off.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 道具の効果は、「鑑定」することでわかるようになるの。鑑定の巻物や杖を使うか、街の魔術士さんに鑑定してもらいましょう。初めて見た道具は使う前にちゃんと鑑定してね。未鑑定だと売却価格も大幅に下がったりするわ。分析スキルが高いなら、持ち歩いている内に鑑定できたりもするけど…時間はかかるわね。
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 今日は、普段持ち歩くべき道具についてお勉強しましょうね。
entries.en: Okay, today I'm gonna cover the items that you should always have with you.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 使わないものは置いていくとして回復とテレポート、食料とシェルターは忘れずに持っていって。杖は微妙に重いから気持ち少なめにね。アイテムを守るために耐火・耐冷ブランケットを１枚ずつ忘れずに。強い敵や未知の土地に挑む場合は、強化用のアイテムをいつもより多く。
entries.en: The must-haves are healing and teleporting items, as well as food and a shelter. Rods are rather heavy, so don't carry too many of them. You should also have one each of fireproof and coldproof blankets to protect your items. When you know you're going to go up against something strong or headed into the unknown, stock up on buffing items.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 駆け出しの間は、１０ｓ以上あるような重いものは、四次元ミラーにでもしまっておいて。重量挙げスキルが育てばそのうち素で持てるようにもなるわ。戦利品を多く持ち帰るためにも、重量・枠に余裕を持ってね。
entries.en: When you're starting off, put items that are 10s or more in a 4-dimensional mirror. Later on, you'll become able to carry them around normally when your Weight Lifting skill is high enough. But always be sure to leave enough inventory space and weight capacity to carry the spoils out of a Nefia.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: いらない物を置くのはdキー…dropだけど、この時＊キーを押すと連続で物を置けるわ。調節する際に便利だから覚えておきましょう。
entries.en: To drop things that you don't need, press the 'd' key. If you want to drop multiple items, then press the '*' key after that. This is invaluable when reorganizing your backpack.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 第３回は、道具の状態について詳しく教えるわね。
entries.en: For part 3, I'll be talking about two possible states that items can have - blessed and cursed.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 信仰している神の祭壇に水を置くと、水が祝福されるの。神を信仰していない場合は、神の支配していない祭壇に水を置けばいいわ。祝福された水を混ぜることでどんな道具でも祝福できるのよ。１スタックまとめて効果があるから、巻物なんかには数十枚貯めてから混ぜましょう。
entries.en: If you drop water onto the altar of a god you are currently worshipping, it becomes blessed water. If you aren't worshipping any god, then just drop it onto an altar that isn't currently claimed by any god. Any item that gets mixed with this blessed water becomes blessed itself. You can bless an entire stack at a go, so you can wait until you've accumulated dozens of a scroll before blessing the whole stack.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 一方、悪夢や敵の呪いで装備が呪われることもあるわ。呪われた装備は外せないうえに、身に着けていると突然テレポートさせられたりダメージを受けたりするの。早めに解呪の魔法や道具を使うか、街の癒し手に解呪してもらいましょう。
entries.en: Sometimes your equipment might get cursed during a nightmare or by an enemy. You can't take off cursed equipment, and while wearing it you'll keep getting hurt or teleported at random. When that happens, you'll want to uncurse it with a spell or a magic tool. Or you can ask the healers in towns to do it for you.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 呪われている食べ物は吐いてしまうし、ポーションや巻物、杖は本来の効果が出なかったり弱まったりしてしまうわ。売値も下がってしまうから、特に理由がなければ祝福された解呪の巻物を使っておきましょう。祝福された解呪の巻物は所持品全部に解呪効果が出る優れものよ。
entries.en: Cursed food make you vomit when you eat. Cursed potions, scrolls, and rods will either have no effect or have their effect weakened. Their prices will also be reduced. To fix that, you can use a blessed scroll of uncurse on them. When blessed, scrolls of uncurse will uncurse each and every single item in your backback. They're great like that.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 最後となる第４回では、装備についてもう少し説明するわよ。
entries.en: For the last part, I'm going to talk a little about equipment.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 分析スキルで自然鑑定が発動するとわかるんだけど、装備には粗悪、良質、高品質、奇跡、神器、特別の６種があるわ。完全に鑑定すると、高品質には接頭語、奇跡には☆と『』、神器には☆と《》、特別には★と《》がつくの。
entries.en: Equipment has 6 ranks - Bad, Good, Great, Miracle, Godly, and Special. Its rank becomes evident when your Analysis skill does its job. When completely identified, then you'll also be able to see the prefix for Great equipment, the bracketed <name> for Miracle, {name} for Godly, and bracketed <name> again for Special equipment.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 高品質、奇跡、神器には特別な力…エンチャントがランダムで付与されるわ。奇跡と神器はランダムアーティファクトと呼ばれていて、高品質以下よりも本体性能もエンチャント面も上限が上なの。特別は固定アーティファクトと呼ばれ、性能が固定されているわ。
entries.en: Great, Miracle, and Godly equipment are unusually powerful. This is due to the random equipment attributes that they come with. Miracle and Godly equipment are also referred to as 'random artifacts' by some people, and these have better base stats and equipment attributes than Great equipment. Special equipment are also called 'unique artifacts'; their equipment attributes and stats are predetermined and will be the same every time you come across them.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 最終的には奇跡以降で装備欄を埋めることになるわね。高品質は奇跡にランクアップさせる方法もあるから、いいエンチャントがついていたら取っておいてね。
entries.en: Every piece of equipment that you wear will eventually be of Miracle quality or greater. There's also a method of promoting Great equipment into Miracle quality, so you find a really nice Great piece of equipment you can save it for later.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 集めるべき巻物は？
entries.en: What kind of scrolls should I stock up on?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 集めるべきポーションは？
entries.en: What kind of potions should I stock up on?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 寝具と調理器具はどれがいいの？
entries.en: Which sleeping and cooking tools should I use?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: れっしぇー歳いくつ？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 杖ってどうなの？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 重すぎるとどうなるの？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 持ち歩かないものはどうするの？
entries.en: What do I do with stuff that's too heavy?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 保持指定って何？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 他に祝福したほうがいい道具は？
entries.en: What other items should I bless?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 呪った方がいい道具は？
entries.en: What items should I curse before using?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: ＋１とかって何？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: れっしぇー恋人いないの？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: いい装備の入手法は？
entries.en: Where do I find good equipment?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 装備の素材って？
entries.en: What does the material of equipment mean?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: マテリアルって何？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 合成の壺って？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 何か質問はあるかしら？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 巻物はとても軽いうえに、スキルがなくても使えるから駆け出し時代に重宝するの。特に鑑定、素材変化、魔法の地図、物質感知、帰還、解呪、武器防具強化、不思議、マテリアル生成あたりをこつこつ集めておくと後で便利よ。よく出る割に単価の高い神託は、交換や売却にも使えるわ。
entries.en: Scrolls are great because they're light and you need no skill to use them. Scrolls of identify, change material, magical map, detect objects, return, uncurse, enchant armor and weapon, wonder, and gain materials are the ones that you should start stockpiling for later. Oh, and scrolls of oracle too, which are common but surprisingly expensive, so you can sell them or use them for trading items.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 大抵は代替手段があるけれど、巻物は軽いから落ちてるのは全回収でオッケー。あと成長、能力獲得、羽の生えた巻物はレアよ。最初はなるべく使わずに、後で必要になる時まで温存しておきたいところね。家具の本棚は家に置くと本や巻物を収納できるから整理整頓に便利よ。
entries.en: Most scrolls have their spell, rod, or potion equivalents, but there's no harm in picking up every single one that you find because they're just so light. Scrolls of growth, gain attribute, and flying scrolls don't, however. And they are very rare finds. You probably shouldn't use them right away either - save them up for when you need them. You can also store scrolls and books in bookshelves that you have at home.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: ポーションは軽くていっぱい持てるの。一部のポーションは錬金術スキルで効果が伸びるから取っておくといいわ。回復系とバフ系、デバフ系、状態異常系、空き瓶、耐酸性コーティング液、耐熱コーティング液…とにかく数を用意しておきたいわね。軽いから落ちてるのは全回収でオッケーよ。
entries.en: Potions are light as well, so you can carry a lot of these too. Some potions have their effects increased by the Alchemy skill, so that might be something you want to get. The ones that you want to stock up on are those for healing, buffing, debuffing, status ailments, empty bottles, and acidproof and fireproof liquids. Or you could just pick up every single one that you find since they're so light.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: あと水、エーテル抗体、潜在能力、下落、進化、ヘルメスの血、スピードリンクはレアだから取りこぼしのないようにね。家具の「ポーションの棚」は家に置くとポーションを収納できるから手に入れておきたいわ。
entries.en: Don't overlook bottles of water, speed upper, and hermes blood, as well as potions of cure corruption, potential, descent, and evolution. These are rare. You can store potions in the rack of potions furniture item when you have it placed at home.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 寝具と調理器具にはランクがあって、それぞれ効果に差があるわ。最初は軽い低ランク品でもいいけれど、多少無理してでも高ランク品に替えていきたいわね。街中にある高ランク品を使うことも、視野に入れておいてね。
entries.en: Sleeping and cooking tools are ranked and hence differ in their effects. Early on, you can just stick with lower ranked once since they tend to be lighter, but you should switch over to higher ranks when you can even though they're heavy. When using the beds and cooking tools that are in town, try to find the highest ranked ones.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: そんな時に便利な道具がインサイトレンズよ！相手の年齢どころか、身長体重種族、そして能力値や弱点耐性まで丸わかり！道具の進歩って素晴らしいと思わない？
entries.en: When you want to know something like that, try using the insight lens! It tells you the target's age, height, race, attributes, and even their elemental weaknesses. Tool are really advanced these days, dont'cha think?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 杖の場合、魔道具スキルが効果だけでなく成功率にも影響するわ。微妙に重いし残り回数が違うとまとまらないから少な目にね。杖の残り回数は充填の巻物や技能の魔力の充填で増やせるわ。魔力の充填は魔道具スキルレベル２０以上の時レベルアップで習得よ。
entries.en: Aha, so you want to know about rods. The Magic Device skill not only affects the effectiveness of rods - it also increases the chance that you'll successfully zap them. They're kinda heavy and don't stack well in your backpack though. The remaining charges on a rod can usually be topped up with scrolls of recharge or the Fill Charge special action. You'll learn the latter when you level up with 20 levels in Magic Device or more.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 回復系と壁生成、テレポート、変化、鑑定の杖は便利ね。それでも残り回数を充填できるようになったら４、５本で充分かな。杖主体で戦う気がないのなら、攻撃系の杖は魔道具上げや残り回数の抽出、元素の神への捧げものに使うといいわ。
entries.en: Rods of healing, wall creation, change creature, and identify are the useful ones. If you're able to recharge them, then 4-5 of each rod should be enough. If you don't rely on rods for their attack spells, then you can draw the charges from those offensive rods or offer them to the god of Elements.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 支配の杖は敵を仲間に引き込むレア杖だけど、魔道具スキルのレベルが支配できる相手のレベルに関わってくるわ。スキルが低いと絶対成功しないから、使うつもりならスキルを上げておきましょう。
entries.en: Rods of domination are rare ones that will recruit enemies as your allies, and the level of enemies they are dominate will depend on your Magic Device skill level. The chance of successfully dominating a target is pretty much negligible with a low skill level, so level it up before zapping these rods.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: バックパックの重量に応じて重荷、圧迫、超過、潰れと変化していくの。重荷くらいなら問題ないけれど、圧迫以降は速度が大きく下がって戦闘が不利になるわ。超過になると歩いているだけでたまに大ダメージを受けるようになるから、そのまま行動してると事故死に一直線よ。どうしても超過で移動しなきゃいけない場合は、時々荷物を降ろして休憩しましょうね。
entries.en: You get Burdened, Burdened!, Overweight, and Overweight! as the total weight of things in your backpack increases. Being Burdened is okay, but any more than that and it will gimp your speed too much, which is dangerous in combat. When at Overweight or worse, you will periodically take damage when moving around, so if you keep pushing yourself like that you can die. If there's something that you absolutely must carry but makes you Overweight, drop it on the ground once in a while and take a break to recover your health.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: ちなみに重量挙げスキルは、重荷以上の時にしか成長しないの。うまく荷物を調整して、普段は重荷で活動・強敵と戦う時は重荷解除、ってできるようにしておきたいわね。
entries.en: And remember, your Weight Lifting skill trains only when you are Burdened or above. You'll have to manage what you carry to keep yourself Burdened, then when in a pinch you can drop enough to remove all encumbrance.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: すぐに使わない道具は、わが家や倉庫に置いておきましょう。死んで落としたり、燃やされたりするわ。軽い巻物やポーションも半分くらいは保管しておいた方がいいわ。ただし場所によってものを置ける数に限界があるの。必要に応じて倉庫を建てるか、掃除されない場所に仮置きするといいわ。
entries.en: Items you don't need often can be left at home or in a storage house. Or else you might end up dropping them when you die or lose them to a fire. That's why it's a good idea to leave about half of your scrolls and potions somewhere safe even though they're light. However, every location has a maximum number of items that you can drop on the ground. You can buy more storage houses when you need them, or just leave them for a bit on maps that don't get periodically cleaned.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 掃除されない場所かどうかは、不要なものを一週間ほど置いて確認してみましょう？大抵の街は置いたものが片づけられてしまうけれど、地下は対象外だったりするのよ。
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: そうそう！置ける道具の種類数は、場所によって決まっているの。限界ギリギリのところに新しい物が生成されると、古い物がいくつか破壊されてしまうわ。これはマップだけじゃなくて、給料箱とかお店の金庫の中も同じなの。定期的に整理整頓して、余裕をもたせておきましょうね。
entries.en: Speaking of storage, the number of different types of items - that is, stacks of items - that you can store is different for different areas and containers. When a new item is created but there's no more space, then a few older items will get destroyed. This applies not only to maps, but also to containers like salary and shop chests. You'll have to clean out their items periodically to make sure they have room to spare.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 保持指定は、調べる…ｘキーで一覧を表示している最中に＊キーでできるわよ。もう一度＊キーで解除されるわ。
entries.en: To tag items as no-drop, just e'x'amine items - 'x' key - then press '*' on an item. Pressing '*' again will unmark it.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 保持指定をした道具は、「大事なもの」として扱われるわ。置いたり売ったりできなくなるから、紛失防止になるの。いくらでも指定できるから、貴重な道具や良い装備は忘れずに指定しておきましょうね？…漫然と道具整理していると、たまに手が滑るのよねぇ。
entries.en: Items that you've tagged as no-drop means that they are important to you. As the name suggests, while tagged, you won't be able to drop those items on the ground or sell them, so you can avoid accidentally losing them. You can tag as many items as you want, so be sure to tag important items and good pieces of equipment. After all, accidents do happen when you're not paying attention.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 杖や巻物は祝福すると効果が強化されるのよ。特に成長、素材変化、羽の生えた巻物はまとめて祝福してから使いたいわ。
entries.en: Rods and scrolls are more effective when blessed. Especially for scrolls of growth, change material, and flying. These you are the ones that you really should bless before using.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 祝福された食品・飲み物は、たまに幸運の日が訪れることがあるの。でもそれ狙いでわざわざ祝福するほどではないわ。祝福されたポーションは効果が上昇するけれど、特に肉体・精神復活と潜在能力、ヘルメスの血は祝福してから使った方がいいわね。
entries.en: When eating and drinking blessed food and drinks, you may sometimes experience a Lucky Day. It's not often enough to warrant deliberately blessing your food though. Blessed potions are more efficacious, but the ones that you really need to bless before using are potions of potential, restore body, restore spirit, potential, and bottles of hermes blood.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 祝福された武器は攻撃力と命中力が、防具は回避力と防御力がわずかにアップするわ。呪いで上書きされちゃうしまとめて祝福できないから、祝福された水が余っていない限り、他の道具に回した方が無難ね。
entries.en: When blessed, the attack power and accuracy of weapons increase. For armour, it's evasion and defence. Unlike other items, however, you can't stack up equipment and bless them all at one go, so you should do this only when you have a lot of blessed water to spare and there are no other items that you need to bless.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 使えそうなのは装備を重くできる呪われた羽の巻物や、体重を重くできる呪われた鈍足とかかしら。呪縛の巻物で呪われた水を作っておくと、呪いたい時に便利よ。
entries.en: The practical ones are cursed flying scrolls that can be used to make equipment heavier and cursed rods or potions of slow to make you or your allies heavier. You can make cursed water with scrolls of curse; cursed water are a lot easier to use than the scrolls for cursing things.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: ちなみに呪縛の巻物が呪うのは所持品からランダム。と、いうことは…？もし所持品が水だけなら…？
entries.en: That's because scrolls of curse will curse a random item that you have on you. So guess what happens when the only thing you're carrying is a bottle of water?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: ＋値ね。基本的に、数値が高いと価格が跳ね上がるわ。食品なら料理、装備や家具なら高級な素材に素材変化するとさらに価格が上がるの。そして、栄養のある食品の場合は元々の能力鍛え効果も強化されるわよ。
entries.en: The +enhance value? For food, it increases the amount of nutrition that they have if they had any in the first place. That means they'll train your attributes more when eaten. The price of items also increases as their +enhance value increases. And by the way, you can increase the price of food even further if they are cooked into a high-ranked dish. For equipment and furniture, you can reroll their material into an expensive one with scrolls of change material to make them more expensive.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 装備の場合は＋の数値分、性能が強化されているってことでもあるわ。武器なら攻撃力と命中力が、防具なら回避力と防御力が少しアップしているの。強化の巻物を使うか、武具店で強化してもらえるわよ。この場合の最大値は＋１０だけど、スターダストを使えば＋１５まで可能よ。。
entries.en: +Enhance value makes equipment more effective. Weapons become more accurate and do more damage, while armour have their evasion and defence increased. The maximum enhance is +10 if you enhance them with scrolls of enchant weapon and armor or have a blacksmith do it for you. If you use stardust, it can go up to +15.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: あと、酸攻撃を受けると装備の＋値が減ったり－になったりするの。当然だけど性能も低下。素材変化で一度でも耐酸能力のある素材に変えれば、別の素材に変えても持続するわよ。もしくは耐酸性コーティング液を混ぜておきましょう。
entries.en: When equipment gets damaged by acid, their +enhance value and thus effectiveness will get decreased and may even go negative. If you change a piece of equipment's material into something acidproof once, it'll remain acidproof forever even if you change it again. You could also mix an acidproof liquid on them.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 喧嘩売ってんのか殺すぞ。
entries.en: Watch your mouth or I'll kill you.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: エンチャントはランダムだから、とにかく数が重要ね。店や依頼で手に入れるだけじゃ足りないわ。こつこつネフィアで拾ったり、誰かから奪ったりしないと。その場合は、高品質以上を狙いましょう。鑑定できる道具を持っていれば、その場で確かめてもいいわね。
entries.en: Since equipment come with random attributes, you'll want to have as many sources as possible to maximize your chances of finding something good. Relying on shops and job rewards isn't going to be enough. Keep an eye out for equipment that's Great or better in Nefia or on other people. If you have a rod or scroll that you can use to identify, then you can determine if they're worth bringing back from a Nefia.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 軽い装備品なら、粗悪や良質でも分析スキル上げに使えるかもしれないわね。でも重い装備はよっぽど重量と枠に余裕がない限り、高品質未満だとわかった瞬間捨てたほうがいいわ。その分他のものを拾いましょう。
entries.en: Light pieces of equipment can be useful even if they are only of Bad or Good quality - carry them around to train your Analysis. As for heavier equipment, it's best to toss them away the moment you find out that they're only Bad or Good unless you have a lot of carrying capacity to spare. Use your spare capacity for something more valuable.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 結婚指輪・首輪、羽、ソックス、スピードの指輪、パンティー、オーロラリング、ヴィンデールクローク、セブンリーグブーツ、フェアリーハットは軽くて固有効果も強いから、粗悪や良質でも拾い集めておきたいわね。特に結婚指輪・首輪は友好を深めるのにも使えるわ。
entries.en: Engagement rings, engagement amulets, wings, sox, speed rings, panties, aurora rings, vindale cloaks, seven league boots, and fairy hats are light and are guaranteed to have certain equipment attributes. These you should pick up even if they're only Bad or Good. Engagement rings and amulets can be used to increase the Impress that someone has for you too.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 素材によって色々な効果があるわ。それに装備の能力も素材に応じて倍率がかかるの。倍率だから、元の性能が低いカテゴリ…指輪や首輪なんかは足りない耐性を補う素材を、元の性能が高いカテゴリは装備能力の高くなる素材を選ぶといいわ。
entries.en: Each material has its own properties and its multiplier for equipment stats. And the fact that it's a multiplier means that you should try to get materials that give resistances for types of equipment that have bad base stats like rings and amulets, and materials that give high multipliers for equipment with high base stats.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 素材変化の巻物は変化する素材が決まっているけれど、祝福すると上位の素材になったりもするわ。他には素材槌っていう対応した素材に確定で変えるものもあるけれど…レアなのよねぇ。神器の装備は素材槌じゃないと素材変化できないから注意よ。
entries.en: Scrolls of change materials change materials to the next one in a predetermined list, with the possibility of changing into the best materials if the scroll is blessed. Material kits which will give you the material that they're for right off the bat, but are rare. And remember: Godly equipment can only be rerolled with material kits.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: マテリアルは重さのない特殊な材料よ。そのままでは使えないけれど、錬金術の道具や工具、宝石加工ツール、裁縫セットで道具を自作する際に必要になるわ。今持っているマテリアルは、mキー…materialで確認できるの。
entries.en: Materials - as in those listed in the 'm'aterial list - are ingredients and are weightless. They're not useful as they are; they're used to create items with the alchemy kit, carpenter's tool, gem cutter, and sewing kit.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: マテリアルはネフィア内にある採取スポットでsキー…search（探す）を行うと手に入るわ。採取スポットの種類に応じて釣り、採掘、栽培、生化学、探知のスキルが必要よ。浅い階層では上位のマテリアルは取れないことと、ネフィアのタイプによって取れる種類が変わることに気をつけて。あと、採取に成功しても失敗しても対応スキルに経験値が入るから、取っておきましょう。
entries.en: Materials are obtained by searching the gathering spots inside Nefia. To 's'earch, either use the 's' key, Space, or Enter. Different types of gathering spots will need different skills for searching - these skills are Fishing, Mining, Gene Engineer, and Detection. Spots on dungeon floors with a low danger level will yield no high-level materials, and the types of materials you can find will also vary with Nefia type. It's good to have these skills, as you will receive experience for them even if you fail while searching.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 工作、錬金術、裁縫、宝石細工のスキルが上がれば、マテリアルで自作できるものも増えていくわ。自作することでも経験値が入るから、積極的に採取スポットで材料を集めていきましょう。仲良くなった仲間がスキルを持っていれば、マテリアルを集めてきてくれることもあるのよ。
entries.en: The number of types of items that you can create with Carpentry, Alchemy, Tailoring, and Jeweler increase as those skills level up. The skills will also level up when you craft items, so be sure to search every spot you come across for materials to be able to craft more items. If an ally has one or more of those skills required for gathering materials and their Impress is high, they'll gather materials for you from enemies too.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 合成の壺なんかを使うと、道具同士を合成して新しいものを自作したり、特殊効果を付与することができたりするわ。特定のスキルや道具が必要になるけれど、本当に色々なことが可能よ。一度確認してみるといいわ。
entries.en: Pot for fusion allows you to fuse items together or imbue them with special effects. There are skill and item requirements to fulfill, but there are many things that you can do with this, so give it a go.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 質問のある人はいるかしら？いたら聞きに来てね。
entries.en: Come up to the front if you have any more burning questions.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 育成講座担当のイヅル・グンバイだ、よろしくな。師範とでも呼んでくれよ。さて、初回はcキー…characterで確認できる能力値について簡単に教えておくぞ。
entries.en: I'm your instructor for the training seminars. You may call me 'Instructor'. To begin with, I'm going to explain the stats on the 'c'haracter sheet, accessible via the 'c' key.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 筋力や耐久といった値が主能力。主能力は対応したスキルや能力、行動を行うことで自然に成長していくんだ。潜在能力は、その能力がどのくらい伸びやすいかを示している。Supreme（至高）は伸びやすさが最大に達した状態だ。そしてHopeless（絶望的）は最低レベルに伸びにくくなっている状態だな。潜在が下がってきたら回復しないと、主能力が全然伸びなくなるぞ。
entries.en: Strength, Constitution and all that are what we call the main attributes. Potentials are how easy they are to raise. The highest is 'Supreme', and the lowest 'Hopeless'. Whenever you use a skill or special action, you will train the attribute that they depend on.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 主能力の潜在を回復させるには、ランクの高い寝具で睡眠を取ることだ。寝る前に得た経験値が多いほど潜在も多く回復するけれど、睡眠を遅らせてまで経験値を稼ぐくらいなら早く寝たほうがマシだぞ！規模の大きい魔法店が稀に入荷する、潜在能力のポーションを飲むのもいいけれど、レアゆえに供給がなかなか追いつかないだろうな。
entries.en: To recover the potentials of your attributes, you need to sleep in a high-ranked bed. The more experience you gain before sleeping, the more potentials you recover while you sleep. Don't stay up just to earn more experience though. It's not worth it. It's better to just go to bed when you need to. High-ranked magic shops will stock potions of potential occasionally. But not often enough that you can depend entirely on just these to raise your potentials.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 主能力に*マークがついているものは、装備によって能力維持…能力が低下しない状態になっている。上昇は普通にするから安心してくれ。能力維持されていないと、敵の弱体化技能や身体を痛めた影響で一時的に下がったりする。下がった主能力は肉体・精神復活の道具か魔法、街の癒し手で戻すといいぞ。
entries.en: Attributes that have a * mark beside them means that they are being maintained by your equipment. That just means that they cannot be temporarily weakened. Don't worry, you can train them and they'll increase just fine. When not maintained, they can get weakened by certain special actions that enemies have, or it can also happen when you don't take care of yourself. When they are weakened, you can restore them with potions of restore body or spirit, or pay a healer in town to do that for you.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: スキルは、トレイナーにプラチナ硬貨を払うことで、習得したり潜在を回復させたりできるぞ。成長させるには経験値の入る行動が必要なんだ。どのスキルに経験値が入っているのかは、スキルトラック…スキルを*キーで登録すればわかりやすいな。ちなみにスキルトラックは最大で15個まで登録できる。
entries.en: Now. Skill potentials. You can pay skill trainers in towns platinum pieces to increase them. To increase their levels, you will need to earn experience for them. You can easily check if a skill is receiving experience by tracking it, which will display it on the left at all times. Track a skill by pressing the '*' key while it's selected.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 今日は仲間…ペットと呼ぶ人もいるが…について軽く教えようか。
entries.en: The topic for today is allies. Also known as pets.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 仲間にできる数は主人の魅力が高まれば少しずつ増えていく。最大１５人まで増えるけれど、枠がないと依頼人やクエスト護衛対象を連れ歩けないから、最低１人分は空けておきたいな。
entries.en: The number of allies you can have increases with your Charisma, up to a maximum of 15. This limit includes people you are currently escorting for a job or quest, so keep at least one slot free at all times.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 仲間は専門の店で買ったり、支配の魔法や杖で支配下に置いたり、モンスターボールで捕まえたりすることで増やせる。倒すことで仲間になる者や、信仰を深めると神からもらえる者もいるぞ。
entries.en: To get allies, you can buy them from some shopkeepers, dominate enemies with the spell or rod, or capture them with a monster ball. Some enemies will also join you when they are defeated, and a few will join you when you have enough favour with your god.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 支配は魔法レベルや魔道具レベルが相手のレベルに比べて低いと成功しない。乱用は難しいけれど即、効果があるんだ。モンスターボールは特にスキルがなくても使えるけれど相手を瀕死にしないと成功しない。上手く使い分けよう。
entries.en: If the level of your Dominate spell - your Magic Device level for the rod of domination - is lower than the target's level, then you will fail to recruit it. These aren't things that you can use haphazardly due to their cost, but their effects are immediate. Monster balls require no skill, but can only be used when targets are nearly dead. Use whichever suits your needs best.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 前回に引き続き、仲間について説明しよう。応用編だぞ。
entries.en: Last seminar, we talked about allies. Today, I'm going to talk about how you can apply what you've learned last time.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 仲間は能力を上げるだけではデコイにすらならないぞ。大抵は能力が同等以上の相手と戦うことになるわけだしな。ちゃんとした装備を与えてやろう。逆に言うと、装備が確保できていない状態で無理に仲間を戦闘に連れていくのはわざわざ殺しにいくようなものだ。
entries.en: Your allies are not going to be useful if all you do is increase their attributes. Not even as decoys. After all, most of the time they're going to be up against something that has higher attributes than they do. That's why equipment is important. Making them fight while they're not properly equipped is no different from leading them to slaughter.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 育てるのは早期から並行してやっておきたいから、仲間をどんどん増やすのは構わない。ただ、装備が揃うまではお留守番させておこう。死なせると友好度も下がって嫌われちゃうぞ。生存率を上げるために、紐と聴診器は必ず使っておこう。仲間を回復するのに手いっぱいになるようなら、装備を見直したほうがいいぞ。
entries.en: Training allies is something you should start early and do in parallel with everything else, so you can have as many of them with you as you want. But keep them out of combat until they have their equipment, or else they'll just die and their Impress for you will fall. To further increase their survivability, use a leash and stethoscope on them. If you find yourself healing them all the time, then you should get them better equipment.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 育て上げ、装備を固めた仲間は安心感が違うぞ。最終的には放っておいても神クラスを余裕で鎮圧するくらいになる。単純に攻撃手段も増えるしターゲットも分散するから、孤独を愛していない限り是非育成してみてくれ！
entries.en: You will find allies that have been trained and properly equipped far more dependable. Eventually, they might even be able to easily go toe-to-toe with a god. Allies are also a source of damage and act as additional targets for enemy attacks. Unless you love being alone, then try to train some allies.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: もう第４回か…早いものだな。今までの話から、育成において潜在がどれだけ重要なのはわかってくれたかな？
entries.en: We're at the fourth part already! How time flies. You probably already know how important potentials are in training.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 最終経験値は、元の経験値量をベースに、潜在と現在能力値によって増減するんだ。能力が低い間は少ない経験値と潜在でももりもり上がっていく。
entries.en: But the skill and attribute levels themselves also matter; these, together with potentials, will determine the final amount of experience received by the skill or attribute. For example, while your attributes are low, they'll grow at a very fast pace even if your potentials for them are terrible.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: だけどある程度能力が上がった後は、潜在や元の経験値量を上げないと最終経験値が微々たるものになってしまうんだ。切り捨てでゼロにすら成り得る。初回で教えたスキルトラックも使って、経験値の入り方を確認するのもいいだろうな。
entries.en: But once your attributes are higher, you will have to increase your potentials or else they won't grow at all. You might even end up with zero growth after rounding occurs. It's times like these when skill tracking comes in handy in making sure that your skills aren't stagnating.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 元の経験値量については…主能力の「習得」が高いと、経験値が稀に増えることがある。あと、召喚された魔物や分裂体からは一切経験値が入らないので気をつけてくれ。こんなところかな？
entries.en: One thing to note is that there is a low chance that your Learning attribute can increase amount of experience gained, and this chance increases with Learning. Oh, and monsters that were summoned or created by splitting give no experience whatsoever.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: おすすめのスキルは？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 技能って？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: プラチナの入手法は？

entries.jp: むうー…どのスキルも使い道があるからなぁ。優先的に取るべきなのは、生存力・成長力に関わる料理、持てる重量を増やす重量挙げ、出費を抑える交渉、他スキルの成長を助ける旅歩き、かな。
entries.en: Hm. That's a difficult one to answer, because every skill has their use. I would say that the first ones you should get are Cooking, which is necessary for survival and training your attributes, Weight Lifting so you can carry more, Negotiation to reduce your expenses, and Traveling to train every one of your skills.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: そこまで揃ったら、探索に役立つ分析、鍵開け、採掘、魔道具などのスキルを、そして目指すスタイルが決まったらそれに合わせたスキルを取ろうか。…まぁ、難しいことは考えず、全部取っても構わないぞ。早期から持っておけば他のスタイルに切り換えるのも楽だろうな。
entries.en: Once you have those, then go for skills that come in handy for Nefia-diving, like Analysis, Lock Picking, Mining, and Magic Device. Once you have those, you should get ones that match the way you do things. It's also okay to just get every skill. If you get every skill early on, you'll be able to switch between fighting styles and whatnot with relative ease later.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 街ごとにトレイナーの教えてくれるスキルは違うんだ。今挙げたスキルならここからすぐ北にあるヴェルニース、東南東にあるヨウィン、西北西にあるポート・カプールで全部揃うけれど、他の街のトレイナーにも確認してみるといいぞ。
entries.en: Trainers in different towns will teach you different skills. The skills I just listed can all be learned from either Vernis just north of here, east-south-east in Yowyn, or west-north-west in Port Kapul. That's just for the ones I listed, so you should also have a look at trainers in other towns.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 例外もあるけれど、技能は主能力やスキルが一定値以上の時にレベルアップすると習得できるんだ。aキー…abilityから発動できる通常技能と、Ｗ(Shift+w)キー…Wideで発動できる広域技能がある。技能が増えてきたら、使わないものは*キーで非表示にしておくといいだろう。
entries.en: Special actions are abilities that you learn upon level up when certain attributes or skills are at certain levels. Most of them, anyway. Regular special 'a'ctions can be used with the 'a' key, and 'W'ide-area special actions with shift+w. When you have too many of them, you can temporarily hide some of them with the '*' key.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: うん！プラチナ硬貨は、主に依頼を達成した時に手に入るぞ。貰える枚数は依頼によって違うが、芸人依頼以外は名声１万とか２万とかごとに増えるからね。他にはネフィアを攻略したり、プラチナベルを倒すことでも手に入るけど、まぁ依頼報酬が基本かな。
entries.en: The main source of platinum pieces is from completing jobs. The number awarded depends on the type of job and on fame; you'll receive 1 more for every 10,000 or 20,000 fame depending on the job. Not for the performing jobs, though. Those only ever give 1 platinum piece. You can also get platinum pieces from clearing Nefia or killing platina bells, but not that much. It's mostly going to come from jobs.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: あー…それか。最初、イヅル・グンバイだからって「いづるん」というあだ名をつけられそうになってな。いい歳してそれは恥ずかしかったから、実家で呼ばれ慣れてる「師範」がいいと駄々をこねさせてもらった。
entries.en: Oh, uh, that. Some people were calling me I-dude, which is kind of strange given my age, so I started insisting on 'Instructor' because I'm used to getting called that at my parents' home.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 仲間の能力を上げたいなら、ランクの高い料理をこまめに与えるといいな。ハーブもいいぞ！潜在能力を高めに保っていれば、食事で能力値２００くらいまではスクスク成長するだろう。
entries.en: Give your allies high-ranked cooked food to increase their attributes. That or herbs. If you keep their potentials high, then their attributes will skyrocket to 200 or so in no time at all.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 聴診器を使えばわかるんだが、青緑色の時は食事可能、桃色の時は満腹だ。腹がすいたらすぐに食わせることができるように、料理は多く持っておくんだ。足りなきゃ果物の木やパン屋から調達しような。ランクの高い料理は仲のいい仲間と一緒に食事することもできる。能力上昇効果はそのままで満腹になりにくいので、活用してみてくれ。
entries.en: When you've used a stethoscope on them, then you'll be able to tell when they're hungry. Blue-green for hungry, pink for full. Bring lots of cooked food so that you can feed them when hungry. When you run out, get more from fruit trees or bakers. High-ranked dishes can be eaten with good friends. The effect of increasing the ability does not change, but the feeling of fullness is halved, so you should try it.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: スキルの潜在能力を高く維持して、対応した行動をとらせよう。特に、戦闘スキルは交戦しないとなかなか伸びないからな。育てたい仲間が交戦する前に、敵を片っ端から先制攻撃で倒したりしないように。経験を積む機会をちゃんと与えてやるのも育成のうちだぞ。
entries.en: You'll have to keep their skill potentials high and make sure that they do things that will train the skills. To train combat skills, they'll have to fight. If you're mincing every single enemy before your allies even have a chance to attack, then they're not going to get any better at it. Part of training them is giving them the chance to earn experience.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 一応、旅歩きスキルを覚えさせていれば旅の中で見識を深め、少しずつ他のスキルも成長していくな。だけどあくまで補助的な経験でしかないから、旅歩きだけで上げようとするのは逆にしんどいぞ。色々な経験をさせてやれるよう、心がけてれば自然と育つもんさ。
entries.en: They do level skills with the Traveling skill, but the amount that they get from just this isn't going to be enough. If you're trying to level them up with only travelling, then it's going to be even harder than if you trained them the proper way. Just give them the relevant experience, pay them some attention, and they'll get better with time.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 仲間に新しいスキルを覚えさせる方法はまたの機会に説明するよ。それまでに、誰がどのスキルを持っているかをちゃんと把握しておこう。仲間に干渉…iキーから情報を開示してもらえるぞ。
entries.en: I'll explain how to teach your allies new skills some other time. In the meantime, make sure you know the skill sets of every one of your allies. You can have your allies disclose information from the i key menu.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 潜在能力が低いままだと、頑張っても経験値が少ないから効率が悪いんだ。お金や宝石類を持たせれば、街で勝手に訓練して主能力とスキルの潜在を高めるぞ。余ってる場合は拾わせてあげよう。
entries.en: Potentials work the same way for your allies. They're not going to receive much experience if they're low no matter how hard they try. This is when you give them money or ores if you have any to spare. They'll use it to visit trainers in towns to increase their attribute and skill potentials.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 訓練に必要な費用は、当人の初期能力…ＩＮＩＴに応じて変わるんだ。ＩＮＩＴが低ければ低いほど、訓練費も少なくて済む。強く成長した後も初期能力依存だから増えない。むしろ魅力が高まればそこからさらに減るのさ。
entries.en: How much they need to train depends on their respective initial stats, the INI. The lower their INI, the cheaper the cost. This cost will never increase even after they get stronger, because the INI doesn't change. In fact, it will even decrease, as there's a discount based on their Charisma.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 死んでしまった仲間は、街のバーテンダーが有料で蘇生してくれるぞ。レベルが高いほど蘇生費用も高くなるので、装備調整と回復はサボらないように。すぐ死ぬ仲間を蘇生させても、対策しなければまたすぐ死ぬだけだ。お金の無駄だぞ。
entries.en: Allies who have died can be revived for a fee at bartenders in towns. It'll get more expensive as their level goes up, so keep them equipped properly and healed up. If they're always quick to die and you don't do anything about it, you're just going to waste money resurrecting them.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 復活の書か、復活の魔法があれば自分でも蘇生できるけど、まぁ前者はレアだし後者は使いこなせるようになるまでが大変だな。
entries.en: You can also do that yourself with a book of resurrection or the Resurrection spell, but the former is too rare and it's difficult to get the latter up to a level that makes it practical to use.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 仲間に活躍させたり、褒めたり、特定の贈り物をするなどで友好度が上がる。友好度が高いと色々と判定が有利になるし、料理スキルがあれば朝食を、裁縫・大工スキルがあれば防具を作ってくれるようになったり、魂の友以上になると結婚もできるようになるんだ。媚薬をぶつけることでも上がるけれど、媚薬だけではお友達までにしかなれないから注意だぞ。
entries.en: Impress of your allies for you increases when they fight, with compliments, and by giving them certain gifts. High Impress is useful for many things. Also, in the morning, they'll make breakfast for you if they have the Cooking skill, and they'll make armour if they have the Tailoring or Carpentry skills. You can even marry them when at Soul Mate or closer. I suppose you could pelt them with love potions, but that will only get them up to Friend status.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 地面にあるものを我慢させ、もし手を出したら押しのけることで、主従度が上がる。いわばシツケだな。色々と従順になるが、友好度でほぼ代用できる。主人として接するのか、対等な立場として接するのか。そこをハッキリさせる、くらいの感覚でいいんじゃないかな。
entries.en: As for Servant/Master value, this increases when they refrain from items on the ground or if you push them off of it when they've started eating it. It basically measures how well they are disciplined. They'll become submissive and obedient as it goes higher, but there's nothing that you can do with it that you can't with Impress. In the end, it's really about whether you want to be their master, or to be their equal.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: タッグを組ませると、ベースにした仲間が移動権を握って行動を共にする。もし二人の攻撃間合いが一致していれば、追随側は移動を省略して攻撃に専念できるわけだ。一致していないと足を引っ張り合うことになるけれどな。強制的に速度が遅いほうに合わせられるから、なるべく速度の近い組み合わせにするといい。
entries.en: When your allies form a tag a team, the ally you had interacted with will be in charge of movement. When both allies in the tag have the same preferred distance from a target, the other ally - the one on the right - can simply leave all the moving to the one on the left and focus on attacking. If they don't have the same preferred distance, they might end up getting in each other's way. They will also both move at the speed of the slowest ally in the tag, so try to team up the ones who have similar speeds.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 似たような戦闘タイプ…特に近接型を組ませて戦闘効率を上げるのは基本だな。庇いあうことで生存力が上がり、取得物が分配されたりするので弱い仲間を強い仲間と組ませて保護してもいいぞ。
entries.en: It's generally best to team up allies who fight in similar ways. By that I mean melee fighters with melee, and ranged with ranged. They will also take damage for each other and share their earnings, which means you can protect weaker allies by tagging them with stronger ones.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 進化には特定のアイテムが必要なんだ。その仲間に対応しているかは使ってみないとわからないし、そもそも対応する進化アイテムがないやつも多い。進化アイテムは特定の敵が落とすぞ。友好度が高くないと進化を拒否されるから仲良くなっておこうな。
entries.en: You need certain items to evolve your allies. Pets. Whichever. Anyway, you won't know if you can use one on your ally until you actually try it out. Some allies also don't ever evolve. If their Impress isn't high enough they'll refuse it. These evolution items are dropped by certain enemies.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 進化すると単純に能力が上がったり、新たな技能を習得するケースもある。姿や名前が変わるけれど、扱い的には元のままで変わっていないから誤解しちゃだめだぞ。
entries.en: When they evolve, allies generally get their attributes increased. In some cases, they learn new special actions too. Their appearance and names will also change, but they other than that they're still the same.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: あまり浸透していないけれど、仲間にスキルを覚えさせる方法としては能力合成っていうのがあるんだ。他の仲間を分解して能力を移植する、生化学文明時代の技術だな。仲間のレベル以上の生化学スキルが必要だ。確か、ポート・カプールの学者が個人レベルでも使えるように研究していたはずだぞ。
entries.en: Not many people know this, but there's a way of teaching your allies new skills called the gene machine. It's a biotechnology relic that breaks down an ally and transfers its abilities into another. I've heard that there's a biologist in Port Kapul who's been researching a method of gene engineering that's easy and simple enough for the average person to use, with the only prerequisite being a Gene Engineer level higher than their allies' character levels.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 能力を合成することで、素体からスキルや装備部位を移植できる。さらに、素体の主能力が上回っていれば最大で３種類＆１０上昇する。料理で上がらなくなる前に、生化学を鍛えてこちらに切り替えていこう。間違って強くしたい方を分解しないように、干渉して大事な仲間に指定しておくのを忘れずに。あと、視界内にいないと能力が上昇したかどうかわからないから気をつけてくれよ。
entries.en: Through gene engineering, you can transfer new skills and body parts to another ally. If attributes are also greater, then up to 3 attributes will get increased by at most 10. Don't forget to designate allies you want as precious from the interference options with them. After all, you don't want to accidentally break down someone. Another thing to note is that if you can't see an ally, you won't be notified when an attribute of theirs increases.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 魔法は、夢で覚えるか、不思議な巻物で覚えるか、魔法書を解読して覚えるかだ。前者ふたつはランダムなのでおまけ程度に考えて、魔法書をメインにしたいな。いずれにしても、手に入れたストックを使い切るとその魔法を再補充する必要があるぞ。
entries.en: Spells are gained from dreams, scrolls of wonder, and reading spellbooks. The first two are completely random so don't depend on them. When you run out of stock for a spell, you'll have to get more before you can cast it again.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 魔法書には種類ごとに難易度があって、相応の読書スキルが必要なんだ。解読に失敗するとＭＰに大ダメージを受けたり魔物が召喚されたりすることもある。何度も失敗するレベルのものを強行したり、倒せない魔物が湧くと困る場所で読んだりしないように。
entries.en: Different spellbooks have different difficulties, and the Literacy skill required to read a spellbook increases with its difficulty. If you fail to read a spellbook, it can do nasty things like drain a whole bunch of your MP or summon monsters. Don't keep trying to read a spellbook that you've failed multiple times in a row already or read in a place where you really don't want monsters to spawn.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 解読で得られる魔法ストックの量は、暗記スキルで増えるから取っておこう。収穫と願いの魔法書以外は充填である程度使いまわすことができるし、一度解読したものは魔術士ギルドに入れば作家から予約して買えるぞ。
entries.en: Memorization skill increases the amount of stock from reading spellbooks, so you'll want to get it. Spellbooks aside from wish and harvest can also be recharged and hence reused for a bit. If you join the Mages' Guild, you can reserve spellbooks that you've successfully read before from their spell writer.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 魔法は使うことで経験値が入り、レベルアップする。詠唱スキルが低いと詠唱成功率が微妙だから、積極的に唱えていこう。魔法にも潜在能力があって、cキーのリストから確認できるぞ。魔法の潜在能力は、スキルなどとは違い睡眠をとることで少しずつ回復していく。
entries.en: Spells receive experience and level up when you use them. Their casting success rate is going to be low while their level is low, so keep using them. Spells also have their own potentials, which you can see from the 'c'haracter sheet pages or from the spell list ('v'). Unlike skill and attribute potentials, you need to recover these by sleeping.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 街の魔術士にプラチナ硬貨を払えば、魔法実習ができる。実習ではストックを消費せずに複数の魔法に経験値が入るぞ。珍しい魔法や普段使っていない魔法も鍛えられるんだ。レベルアップすると詠唱成功率と効果が上昇するから最初に何回か受けておくのもいいだろう。ただし消費ＭＰもちょっと増えるから注意だ。
entries.en: You can attend magic practice sessions if you pay the wizard in towns some platinum pieces. Magic practice will give experience to a set of spells all at once at no stock cost. This will train even the rare spells and those spells that you normally never use. As spell levels increase, their casting success rate also increases, so you should definitely attend at least a few sessions of it. Be careful though about MP costs though. They increase together with the spell levels.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: ちなみに、仲間の魔法は種類に関係なく一括管理されているぞ。魔法レベル＝詠唱スキルレベルに簡略化されているから、その仲間の詠唱スキルを上げていこう。範囲魔法を使う場合は、自分も仲間も魔力制御スキルが必須レベルなので忘れずに。
entries.en: By the way, spells for your allies don't work that way. The level of every spell they use is their Casting skill level, so you'll have to level up that skill for your magic-using allies. Note that if either you or your allies use area of effect spells, then Control Magic is a must for everyone of you.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: ＡＰっていうのは能力の覚醒に必要なポイントだ。一定の強さ以上の敵を倒すことで入手できるぞ。倒した時に何かがひらめくような感覚があるからわかるはずだ。
entries.en: AP is short for Awakening Points, points that you need to awaken to new powers. You get them by defeating enemies that are strong enough. You'll know when you receive AP if you experience something like a flash of inspiration after defeating something.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 入手には色々と細かい条件があるけれど、だいたいＩＮＩＴや速度が自分より高い相手が対象になるんだ。つまり、ＩＮＩＴが低い…最初は弱い者ほどＡＰが貯まりやすいってことだな。
entries.en: The actual requirements for gaining AP are a little complicated, but to put it simply what you need to do is defeat an enemy that has a higher INI and speed than you. So people who have low INI - those who were weak to start with - will gain AP a lot easier.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 噂ではＡＰを使って能力強化やスキル成長、特殊なフィート取得ができるって話だけれど…。少なくともノースティリスでそんなことができるという者は知らないぞ。もし本当なら、育成のために積極的に強い敵を倒してＡＰを入手していきたいな。
entries.en: I've heard that this AP can be used for improving attributes, skills and obtaining special feats... but there's no such person in North Tyris capable of doing that. If it's true, then it would make it worthwhile to seek out strong enemies to earn AP.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 恥ずかしいから師範と呼んでほしい…！！
entries.en: Would you please call me Instructor? That name's kind of embarrassing...
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: あー…実家の道場はずっと南の方にあってね。有料だけど仲間を枠から外して預けることができる。冒険している間に少しずつ鍛えてもらえるし、有料で全員まとめて潜在を回復させたりもできる。宣伝じゃないけど、まぁ活用してみてくれ。
entries.en: ...my family runs a doujou in the south. It's not free, but you can leave your allies there to free up a slot. They'll also train while you're off adventuring, and for another fee you can recover all the potentials of all allies there at once. I'm not trying to advertise here, but go have a look at it sometime.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 何か質問があったら聞きに来てくれ。
entries.en: If you have any more questions come see me.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: こんにちは！ミトリンこと、戦闘講座担当ミト・リディアンだよ。よろしくね。
entries.en: Hi guys, I'm Mitolyn a.k.a. Mito Lydian, the combat lecturer.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 戦闘は、生計を整えて道具をそろえて育成した先にあるものだから、他の先生たちの講座を先に体験してからのほうがスムーズかもね。
entries.en: I'll start of by saying that combat is something that you should be doing after getting all the items you need and trained yourself a little. So you're better off taking the other seminars first if you haven't already.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: そもそも、ある程度準備が整うまでは、街の討伐依頼すら危険だよ！無理な戦闘はしないでね。体力を一度に数割削ってくるような相手に出会ったら、返しで倒す自信がない限りすぐに逃げよう。手こずるような相手を複数相手にするのも避けようね。敵がうじゃうじゃいるところに突撃なんてもってのほかだよ。
entries.en: In fact, it's dangerous to even take on hunting jobs in towns if you aren't prepared well enough! Picking fights you can't win is a no-no. If you come across an enemy that takes a whole chunk out of your health in an instant, then you should run away immediately if you don't think you can match up to that. And don't try to take on multiple enemies if you already have trouble with just one of them. Also don't go charging into places filled with enemies.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 初心者だと、攻撃が全然当たらない相手や、ダメージをほとんど与えられない相手に、ムキになって殴りかかっている間に敵に囲まれたり体力を削られていくパターンもあるよ。少しずつでいいから相手の特性を覚えていって、優先順位を考えて動けるようになろうね。
entries.en: Some enemies keep evading your attacks. Or they might be really tough and your attacks do next to no damage. If you let your temper get to you after missing so many attacks and keep trying to hit it, you might find yourself surrounded before you know it. You'll always need to know which enemies to take out first, but to know that you'll need to remember the characteristics of every type of enemy, so start working on that.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 戦闘講座始めるよー。今日もがんばろうね！
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: んー…。まず、強い冒険者っていうのは能力値が高いって意味ではないの。能力値が１００あっても１０００あっても、能力値の劣る相手にしか勝てないんじゃ強いとは言えないよね。そんなの野生動物と変わらないよ。
entries.en: You know, strong adventurers don't just have high attributes. If they are only able to win against enemies that are weaker than them, then you can't really call that strong, even if their attributes are in the 100s or in the 1000s. That's be no better than what a wild animal is capable of.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 本当に強い冒険者は、あらゆる物の使い方を知っているわ。個々の要素の力を最大限に引き出して、自分の数倍の能力を持つ相手を安定して殺すの。勝てないほどの差があっても、相手の戦い方を見極めたうえで生還して次につなげ、最後には勝つんだよ。
entries.en: The truly strong adventurers are able to use all the resources available to them to their fullest potential to kill enemies that have several times their own attributes. Even if they aren't able to win, they would be able to fully understand how their opponent fights, survive, and then win the next time they meet.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 事前準備の段階からもう戦闘は始まっているんだよ。防御は固めず回復手段も逃走手段も用意せずに戦いに行くのは、冒険じゃなくて自殺行為だってことを覚えておいてね。
entries.en: Combat begins the moment preparations for it start. To go into a fight without proper equipment, healing methods, and some means of escaping is not adventuring. It's suicide, plain and simple.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 戦闘講座第３回…ともなると、そろそろみんなも自分の得意武器や戦闘スタイルが固まってきた頃じゃない？今日はメインウェポン以上に大切な、サブウェポンについて教えるね。
entries.en: This is our 3rd session... which means that you all should have more or less settled on a combat style and a weapon of choice by now. I'm going to talk about something that's even more important than your main weapon - your sub weapon.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 今はまだ単純に武器で殴ったり魔法の矢を撃ったりするだけでいいかもしれない。でも冒険を進めていくうちに、物理攻撃に強い敵や魔法に強い敵、属性攻撃をほぼ無効化する敵なんかと戦うことになるの。そうした時にサブウェポンとして別系統の攻撃手段がないと、有効打を与えられずに死ぬほど苦労することになるよ。なんだかこの敵全然削れないな？と思ったらサブウェポンを試してみよう。
entries.en: You might be doing well now just by clubbing enemies on the head with your weapon or firing Magic Darts. In your adventures, however, you will encounter enemies that are resistant to physical attacks or to spells, or immune to elemental attacks. It's times like these when you will need have a sub weapon as a different source of damage, or else you'll find it really hard to break the stalemate. When you find an enemy who isn't affected by your attacks, it's time to try your sub weapon.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 物理型なら武器のエンチャントで属性攻撃ができるから、得意スキルに依存する無属性攻撃技能をひとつくらいでいいよ。魔法使いなら攻撃魔法を魔法属性とそれ以外に好きな属性からひとつ選ぶ感じで。範囲攻撃魔法も使えるようになっておこう。
entries.en: Physical attackers can have weapons that come with equipment attributes that deal elemental damage, so they have that covered. What they do need is to find a special action that is based off a skill that they are good at. Spellcasters should know a magic-element attack spell and another one of an element of their choice, and also be able to use area of effect spells.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 攻撃手段が異なる仲間を複数そろえて、仲間自体をサブウェポンみたいに使うって手もあるね。相性の悪い相手の時は回復に専念することになっちゃうけど。とにかく、勝ち筋を増やしておいて損はないよ。
entries.en: You can also have allies who use different means of attacking and regard them as your sub weapons. Against enemies that they're bad against, however, you might find yourself having to heal them all the time. Anyway, just try to get more ways of securing victory, as you can never can have too many of those.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: みんなはこの先、冒険の中で本当に色々な敵と戦うことになるよ。単純なステータスや防御力や回避力だけじゃない、特殊な能力を持っていたりする敵も多いから、対策を知らないと苦戦するかも。
entries.en: You are all going to be fighting a very vast range of enemies in the future. They won't just have higher attributes, defence, or evasion; you'll also have to deal with those with special abilities. If you don't know how to counter these abilities, you're going to be in for a tough time.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 相手が『』《》つきじゃないなら、状態異常や変化の杖でどうにでも処理できるんだけど、ね。最後となる、第４回では具体的にそういう厄介な敵の対処法を教えるね。
entries.en: That said, you can always use rods of change creature or status ailments against enemies that don't have <> or {} brackets around their names to get rid of them. I'll be talking about how to fight these enemies in our last seminar next time.
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 上手く逃げるには？
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: 敵の強さを知るには？
entries.en: How do I know how strong an enemy is?
entries.label: label_3036

entries.jp: どのくらいの難易度に挑めばいいの？
entries.label: label_3036
